entities.name: Torkil Damhaug
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Torkil Damhaug is a Norwegian physician and crime fiction writer. He has been awarded the Riverton Prize three times, in 2011, 2016, and 2022, and is the first person to receive the prize three times.
